content:
Former "Home Improvement" actor Jonathan Taylor Thomas was arrested in Westlake Village, California on Monday morning on charges of obstructing police and being drunk in a public place.

According to TMZ, which first reported the news, the 45-year-old former child star was sitting in a vehicle that had been pulled over by local police.

Law enforcement told People magazine that while officers were dealing with the driver, "Mr. Taylor decided to get out of the vehicle himself."

After officers told the former teen idol to get back into the vehicle, he allegedly became uncooperative, refused to follow instructions and obstructed the investigation.

Thomas was taken to a local jail, where he was booked at around 1:50 a.m. on Monday, and released about 34 hours later.

HuffPost has reached out to Thomas but did not immediately receive a response.

As of Wednesday afternoon, authorities had not formally charged Thomas, and information about the vehicle involved and the arrests of other individuals had not been released.

Thomas starred in "Home Improvement" from 1991 to 1998, but has kept a relatively low profile in recent years, though he did make several appearances between 2013 and 2015 on Tim Allen's sitcom "Last Man Standing," in which he played the "TV dad."

Thomas is not the only "Home Improvement" actor to have run into legal trouble.

Tim Allen served two years in prison for drug trafficking before becoming famous, and Thomas's other on-screen brother, Zachery Ty Bryan, pleaded guilty to a felony assault charge in 2023.
